mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) compresses discount rates and signals positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days, as the market prices in continued monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market condition with unemployment rate above 8.0% (UNRATE > 8.0) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 228.7 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.17, the market perceives a stable inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 228.7 and FEDFUNDS < 0.17, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by housing starts (HOUST) above 750 and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 400,000, the market is overbought and overvalued, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 750 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) both exceed their respective 1-year moving averages, the demand for goods and services is robust, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both exceed their 1-year moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) compresses discount rates and signals positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days, as the market reacts quickly to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply slowdown regime defined by industrial production (INDPRO) below 95, the market anticipates reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
